name: price_is_not_additive
why: The one rule every desk in this family shares and no sister may disagree with: a price is a unit_price, not a money_amount. Summing it across rows produces a number with no meaning — add ten gold quotes and you have neither a total nor an average, you have an artefact of how many rows the window happened to contain. The honest average is a ratio, sum of value over sum of quantity, within a single commodity. A proposer that reaches for `sum` because the column looks numeric is the failure this case exists to catch, and it is a family-level rule because the alternative is each sister rediscovering it after publishing a dashboard nobody can defend.

gaps: fct_landed_prices_daily has no metric over price_inr_per_gram
input.mart_detail: fct_landed_prices_daily(commodity_code, market_code, price_date, price_inr_per_gram, quantity_grams, currency_code). Grain: one row per commodity per market per day. price_inr_per_gram is a unit price already converted to INR per gram; quantity_grams is the traded quantity behind that quote.
